about: SEO calendar template for a new site. One-time launch steps (kind once, due = launch date + offset_days), recurring tasks (kind every, every N days) and event tasks (kind event). who = cron: a script or the scheduled GitHub workflow does it; who = human: a person does it in a dashboard. Create a site calendar with: python scripts/seo_calendar.py init --site example.com --launch YYYY-MM-DD

tasks.what: Write a one-page site passport: canonical host (with or without www), stack and rendering (SSR or client), where product data lives, who owns each dashboard account, who may deploy.
tasks.check: The passport file exists in the repo and names an owner for every account.

tasks.what: One host only: http to https and the other www variant to the canonical host with a permanent redirect (301 or 308) that keeps the path. No redirect chains. No open redirect on //other-host/ paths.
tasks.check: python scripts/seo_check.py <host>: redirects, trailing-slash and open-redirect are OK.

tasks.what: HTTPS certificate: write down the expiry date and who renews it. If it does not renew itself, add a calendar task one month before expiry.
tasks.check: seo_check.py: tls-expiry is OK (more than 21 days left).

tasks.what: robots.txt: everything that must rank is open, CSS and JS are not blocked, an absolute Sitemap: line is present. Decide the AI crawler policy (seo-geo) and write it down. For Yandex, Clean-param for tracking parameters.
tasks.check: seo_check.py: robots-txt and ai-bots. Google Search Console robots.txt report; Yandex Webmaster robots.txt analysis.

tasks.what: sitemap.xml built from data: only canonical URLs that answer 200 and are indexable. lastmod changes only when the page content really changes, not on every build.
tasks.check: seo_check.py: sitemap and sitemap-urls are OK. Sitemap reports in Search Console and Yandex Webmaster.

tasks.what: Every indexable page: absolute self-canonical, unique title and description, one h1, html lang, viewport, Open Graph image, robots meta with max-image-preview:large.
tasks.check: seo_check.py: titles, descriptions, h1, lang-viewport, open-graph, image-preview.

tasks.what: JSON-LD: Organization or a store type with @id, WebSite on the home page, Product with Offer (price, priceCurrency, availability) only where the price is visible on the page, BreadcrumbList. No ratings copied from other platforms, no self-serving review markup on the organization.
tasks.check: seo_check.py: json-ld, organization, website, product-offer, self-ratings. Then Rich Results Test and the Yandex structured data validator on 3 pages.

tasks.what: Unknown URLs answer 404 or 410 (no soft 404). The 404 page links to the catalog. Never noindex on a 5xx error page: a robot that catches an outage drops the page. Removed products: 301 to the closest page or 410.
tasks.check: seo_check.py: not-found is OK. Review the 5xx template in code.

tasks.what: Images in webp or avif with width, height and alt. Hashed static files with a long cache. Source maps not public. Compression (gzip or br) and HTTP/2.
tasks.check: seo_check.py: images, static-cache, source-maps, transport.

tasks.what: Core Web Vitals at the 75th percentile: LCP up to 2.5 s, INP up to 200 ms, CLS up to 0.1, mobile first.
tasks.check: PageSpeed Insights on the home page, a category and a product page. CrUX data appears only after enough visits.

tasks.what: Trust pages: contacts with address and phone as text, delivery, returns and warranty, privacy policy, terms, seller details. Yandex names address, details and contacts among signals for search and Alice answers.
tasks.check: Each page opens in two clicks from any page and matches the business profiles.

tasks.what: Google Search Console: domain property (DNS), submit the sitemap, check that the site is included in generative AI features (AI Overviews and AI Mode). Excluded sites get no impressions from those features.
tasks.check: Verified owner; sitemap status Success; generative AI setting shows included.

tasks.what: Yandex Webmaster: verify rights (HTML file, meta tag or DNS TXT), add the sitemap, link Yandex Metrica, set the site region (one region as a rule, or through Yandex Business).
tasks.check: Rights verified; sitemap processed; region passed moderation.

tasks.what: Bing Webmaster Tools: add the site (import from Search Console is allowed), submit the sitemap.
tasks.check: Site verified; sitemap processed.

tasks.what: IndexNow: generate a key, host it at /<key>.txt, store the key as a CI secret. One submission reaches Bing, Yandex, Seznam, Naver, Amazon and Yep. Google does not take part.
tasks.check: seo_check.py --indexnow-key KEY: indexnow-key is OK; python scripts/indexnow.py --site https://<host> --key KEY --check-key.

tasks.what: Analytics: privacy policy first, then the counter (Yandex Metrica or GA4), goals for call, form and order, e-commerce events (view item, add to cart, purchase), bot filtering. Without this, SEO cannot be tied to money.
tasks.check: Test order and test call show up as goals; the e-commerce report shows the test purchase.

tasks.what: Business profiles (Yandex Business, 2GIS, Google Business Profile where eligible): the same name, address, phone and hours as on the site, the main category, an exact map pin, the site URL. Business name as on the sign, no keywords added.
tasks.check: NAP table: site and every profile match character by character.

tasks.what: Product feeds where they apply: YML feed in the Yandex Products account (check its current store requirements first), Google Merchant Center only if you can sell to that country.
tasks.check: Feed status in the Yandex Products account (review takes up to 5 working days) or in Merchant Center.

tasks.what: Own product descriptions (not the supplier text), instructions and FAQ inside product pages, one guide for the main buying question, chosen by measured demand.
tasks.check: No product page shares its description with the supplier site; the guide answers one demand cluster.

tasks.what: AI crawler policy: keep search and user bots open (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot) if you want citations; training bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot) are your choice. YandexAdditional ignores the * group: block it only in its own group and only if you do not want Alice answers to show your content.
tasks.check: seo_check.py: ai-bots shows the policy you chose.

tasks.what: llms.txt is optional and low priority: Google says it neither helps nor harms, and no major AI search has said it reads it. If you keep one, generate it from the same data as the site.
tasks.check: seo_check.py: llms-txt shows INFO; never spend launch time here.

tasks.what: Baseline and decision log before the first SEO change: snapshot of Search Console, Yandex Webmaster and analytics, then one line per change (date, what changed, other changes at the same time, control pages, review date).
tasks.check: templates/decision-log.md copied to the site repo with the first line filled.

tasks.what: Uptime monitor with an alert after two failures in a row. The daily workflow catches a dead site once a day; for minutes use an uptime service.
tasks.check: A test outage raises an alert.

tasks.what: Create the site calendar and copy the scheduled workflows: seo-daily, seo-weekly, seo-monthly, seo-on-deploy.
tasks.check: python scripts/seo_calendar.py validate passes; the first scheduled runs are green.

tasks.what: Final check on launch day: full seo_check.py with a larger sample, no FAIL; each WARN either fixed or written down as a decision.
tasks.check: python scripts/seo_check.py <host> --pages 20 exits 0.

tasks.what: Two weeks after launch: which sitemap URLs are indexed in Google and Yandex. Pages that are discovered or crawled but not indexed: improve content or internal links, do not resubmit them every day.
tasks.check: Search Console Pages report and Yandex Webmaster Pages in search.

tasks.what: Four weeks after launch: first read against the baseline (impressions, clicks, positions, goals). No conclusions from single-digit numbers.
tasks.check: One line in the decision log with numbers and their source.

tasks.what: Health check: home, robots.txt, sitemap and sampled sitemap URLs answer as expected, certificate days left.
tasks.check: Scheduled workflow seo-daily (seo_check.py --pages 3) is green.

tasks.what: Submit to IndexNow only the URLs whose lastmod changed since the last run. Unchanged URLs are not sent; one URL not more often than every 10 minutes.
tasks.check: seo-daily log: indexnow.py answered 200 or 202, or had nothing to send.

tasks.what: Read messages from Search Console, Yandex Webmaster and Bing: critical errors, manual actions, security issues.
tasks.check: A mail filter puts these messages in one folder; the folder is empty or each message has an action.

tasks.what: Full external audit with a bigger sample.
tasks.check: Scheduled workflow seo-weekly (seo_check.py --pages 12) is green; new WARN lines are read.

tasks.what: Index snapshot: Search Console Pages and Performance; Yandex Webmaster Diagnostics and Pages in search. Compare with last week.
tasks.check: One line in the decision log: indexed pages, impressions, clicks, new errors.

tasks.what: AI visibility: Search Console Generative AI performance report (impressions only) and Yandex Webmaster report on site visibility in Alice AI answers (updates weekly).
tasks.check: Numbers written to the decision log with the report date.

tasks.what: Every new review on maps and platforms has an answer; aim for an answer within a day.
tasks.check: No review of the week without an answer.

tasks.what: Analytics week: organic and AI referral sources (chatgpt.com, perplexity.ai and others), goals and orders from organic.
tasks.check: Week line in the decision log.

tasks.what: Server logs: hits by Googlebot, YandexBot, Bingbot and AI bots; 4xx and 5xx to robots; 403 or 429 sent to search robots by a firewall.
tasks.check: No search robot gets 403 or 429; 5xx to robots is near zero.

tasks.what: AI answer spot check by a fixed protocol: the same 10 questions in Yandex with Alice, Google AI Mode or AI Overviews, ChatGPT search and Perplexity. Record: is there an AI answer, is the site among sources, which competitors are.
tasks.check: Protocol table with date, question, engine, cited yes or no.

tasks.what: Pages with impressions but few clicks over the last 28 to 90 days: rewrite title and description, keep control pages unchanged, review in 4 weeks.
tasks.check: Decision log lines for each changed page with the review date.

tasks.what: Rich Results Test on 5 to 10 product pages; product snippet and merchant listing reports in Search Console; Yandex structured data validator.
tasks.check: No errors in price and availability.

tasks.what: Organic to money: e-commerce report and goals for organic traffic, reconciled with real orders and calls (order number or ClientID). Compare periods with one attribution model.
tasks.check: Month line: organic orders and revenue, source of each number.

tasks.what: Business profiles against the site: photos, products and prices, hours, phone. A rating shown on the site equals the rating on the map and links to the reviews.
tasks.check: NAP table and rating check have no differences.

tasks.what: Content cadence: 1 to 3 new guides or comparisons, or updates of old ones, by measured demand. A slow queue with a quality gate beats volume.
tasks.check: Each new page has a demand note, a fact check and review dates at 7, 21 and 90 days (seo_calendar.py track).

tasks.what: Query gap pass: export the last 12 months of queries from Search Console (Performance, Export) and from Yandex Webmaster, then list queries where the site is already visible but no page targets them, queries at positions 8 to 20, and top-5 queries with weak CTR. Turn the gaps into page tasks.
tasks.check: python scripts/gsc_gaps.py Queries.csv --sitemap https://<host>/sitemap.xml --format md; each accepted topic gets an event-new-page entry.

tasks.what: Open one issue with the human tasks due in the next 31 days.
tasks.check: Scheduled workflow seo-monthly created the issue.

tasks.what: Full technical crawl with a desktop crawler; compare with the last crawl to catch template regressions.
tasks.check: Crawl export saved; new issues listed in the decision log.

tasks.what: Links and brand mentions: new referring domains, anchors, mentions without links, competitors. No bought links: Yandex and Google both penalize link schemes.
tasks.check: Quarter line in the decision log.

tasks.what: Seasonal pages: plan guides 6 to 8 weeks before the season starts.
tasks.check: Season calendar lists the next two seasons with their pages.

tasks.what: Re-read search engine rules, AI crawler pages and dashboard changes; update the checked dates in this calendar and in the skills. Facts about search engines go stale.
tasks.check: Every source checked within the last 91 days.

tasks.what: Prune or merge thin pages that got no impressions in 90 days; read the 90-day measurements of new pages.
tasks.check: Each pruned page has a 301 or 410 and a decision log line.

tasks.what: security.txt: extend the Expires field (RFC 9116).
tasks.check: seo_check.py: security-txt is OK.

tasks.what: Review trust pages and seller details: legal changes, new delivery terms, contacts.
tasks.check: Each trust page shows a review date.

tasks.what: After every deploy: seo_check.py on the live site, then IndexNow for changed URLs.
tasks.check: Workflow seo-on-deploy is green.

tasks.what: New page: demand note before writing; after publishing, add review tasks at 7, 21 and 90 days and a rollback rule.
tasks.check: python scripts/seo_calendar.py track <url> --on <publish date>

tasks.what: Price or stock change: page, structured data and feed show the same price; lastmod moves; business profile items updated one by one.
tasks.check: Page, JSON-LD and feed carry the same price; IndexNow sent the URL.

tasks.what: Traffic drop runbook: check the Google Search Status Dashboard and Yandex Webmaster news first, then dashboard errors, server logs and the last deploys; compare equal windows before and after; roll back one change at a time.
tasks.check: Decision log line with the cause found or the next check.

tasks.what: Core update: wait at least one full week after the rollout ends, then compare the week after with the week before the start. Core updates do not target single sites; recovery can take months.
tasks.check: Decision log line with both windows.

tasks.what: Redesign or domain move: redirect map for every old URL, crawl before and after, watch indexing for 4 to 8 weeks.
tasks.check: Crawl after the move: no old URL answers 404.

tasks.what: Dashboard data outage: mark the window in the decision log and do not compare it with normal periods. Example: Yandex Webmaster tools were limited from 11 October 2026 and partly restored on 23 November 2026.
tasks.check: Decision log has the excluded window with a source.
